business_summary: Broad-minded Co.,Ltd. engages in the financial partner business in Japan. It provides consulting services related to financial planning, such as insurance, mortgages, asset management, and retirement savings, as well as corporate financial planning. The company also develops and offers digital products related to financial and economic education and financial well-being, as well as plan, develop, and sell constructed reinforced concrete (RC) apartment buildings; and provides real estate consulting services. In addition, it is involved in the life insurance, non-life insurance, small-amount short-term insurance agency, and financial product brokerage business; and housing loan and bank agency businesses. Further, the company engages in sales of real estate; operation of financial education schools; and financial planning consultation, subscription-based consulting, and marriage consulting agency services. Additionally, it offers Broccoli, a financial education platform for corporate employees; MoneyPass, a life plan simulator that serves as a financial compass for living the life; Broadtalk, an online interview system specifically designed for business-to-consumer meetings; and Broadconnect, a call system specializing in outbound calls. Broad-minded Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 2002 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.
